BEFORE YOU CONTACT US

Make the conversation
focus on your needs

Send the information you already have; we can clarify the remaining details together.

01

Which product do you need?

The fish or squid name, processing requirements and preferred size. If you are unsure of the name, describe the product or email a photo.

02

What quantity are you planning to order?

Quantity, units, whether the requirement is one-off or recurring, and the required delivery date.

03

Where will the goods be delivered?

The destination, intended market, and any packaging, labeling or documentation requirements to be discussed.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Before we work together

Can I inquire about custom specifications?

You can share processing requirements, sizes, pack weights and labeling needs. MAI KỲ HÀ SEAFOOD will discuss availability for each product and shipment.

How can I request pricing and delivery information?

Send the product name, specifications, quantity, destination and required delivery date. Pricing and timing are discussed after your requirements have been clarified.
